Sugs Lloyd: Executing India’s Energy Future

Sugs Lloyd is an agile company with robust engineering capabilities, field execution experience, and sector understanding to deliver reliable infrastructure solutions across power, solar, civil, and automation projects. Our strength lies in analytics, in-house tech- driven tools, disciplined project management, and a strong understanding of Indian utility and infrastructure requirements.

India's infrastructure growth story is entering a new phase of growth, and we believe we are positioned at the right place, with the right capabilities, at the right time. With 17 years of experience, proprietary products, strong execution capabilities, and an expanding market presence, Sugs Lloyd aims to build a long-term compounding growth story.​

About Us

Established in 2004, Sugs Lloyd Limited has evolved into a technology-driven leader in the field of engineering and construction. Founded by a team of visionary entrepreneurs, the company has grown into a diversified multi-product engineering powerhouse.

Our Vision

To be the trusted, technology-driven leader in renewable energy and power infrastructure, consistently delivering high-impact, sustainable EPC solutions that power a brighter future for communities and all stakeholders.

Our Values

At Sugs Lloyd, we operate around core values of quality, dependability, timeliness, and technological innovation. Our commitment is to address the 21st century's greatest challenges: making energy accessible to all, protecting the planet, and acting responsibly towards future generations.

Our Mission

To create a system-driven organization that leverages advanced technology and deep sector expertise to execute complex solar, T&D, and civil projects with unmatched efficiency and quality, ensuring timely completion and creating enduring value for society and all stakeholders.

To deliver customer satisfaction through reliable and innovative infrastructure solutions that power progress with precision, safety, accountability, and engineering excellence, while integrating technology and innovation into every aspect of our work.

Values

Integrated Capabilities. Reliable Delivery.

Our service portfolio combines engineering excellence, technology integration, project management, automation, and operations support to deliver infrastructure projects with greater control, coordination, and accountability.

Transmission and Distribution Infrastructure for a Stronger & Smarter Grid

We deliver power transmission and distribution infrastructure for utilities, DISCOMs, PSUs, renewable energy developers, and industrial clients. Our expertise lies in EHV substations and transmission lines up to 400 kV, along with 33 kV and 11 kV distribution substations, networks, and smart grids (ADMS/ DAS).

View More

Solutions Built for Long-Term Performance 

We deliver power transmission and distribution infrastructure for utilities, DISCOMs, PSUs, renewable energy developers, and industrial clients. Our expertise lies in EHV substations and transmission lines up to 400 kV, along with 33 kV and 11 kV distribution substations, networks, and smart grids (ADMS/ DAS).

Civil Infrastructure Delivered with Precision

We undertake civil construction for substations, warehouses, corporate offices, and allied infrastructure. Our approach focuses on planning, quality, safety, and timely execution.

Expanding from Smart Products to Smart Grids

We design and deploy Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS)/ Distribution Automation Systems (DAS) that help DISCOMs improve network visibility, fault response, and operational reliability. Our solutions support reduction in AT&C losses, faster decision-making, better control, and improved service continuity.

View More

Rooftop Solar Power Systems

Our rooftop systems efficiently utilize available roof space to reduce energy costs, improve sustainability,
and enhance energy independence.

Ground-Mounted Solar Power Plants

SUGS Lloyd undertakes large-scale ground-mounted solar power projects

These solar plants are engineered for high efficiency, durability, and scalability, making them suitable for
long-term and utility-scale energy requirements.

Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

To ensure uninterrupted and reliable power supply, SUGS Lloyd offers Battery Energy Storage Systems(BESS) integrated with solar installations or as standalone solutions.

Our BESS Capabilities Include:


 Energy storage for peak shaving and load balancing
 Backup power for critical government and institutional infrastructure
 Grid stabilization and renewable energy smoothing
 Integration with rooftop and ground-mounted solar plants
 Support for hybrid and off-grid applications


BESS solutions help optimize energy usage, improve grid reliability, and maximize the value of
renewable energy generation.

Our Offerings

Choose SUGS Lloyd for Solar

Smart O&M with AI, Real-Time Remote Monitoring & Analytics

SUGS Lloyd Limited offers advanced Operations &amp; Maintenance (O&amp;M) services powered by AI-
enabled platforms, Real-Time Remote Monitoring &amp; Analytics, ensuring maximum uptime and optimal
performance of solar and BESS assets throughout their lifecycle.

Key Smart O&amp;M Capabilities:


 24/7 Real-Time Remote Monitoring &amp; Analytics of solar plants and BESS
 AI-driven performance analysis for early fault detection and efficiency optimization

 Predictive maintenance through intelligent data insights to minimize downtime
 Automated alerts and diagnostics for rapid issue resolution
 Real-time generation, storage, and consumption reporting
 Enhanced asset life, reliability, and operational transparency


By combining on-ground technical expertise with digital intelligence and analytics, we deliver proactive
maintenance, improved system availability, and long-term performance assurance—especially critical for
Government and PSU projects.
